description: This file defines constants, types, and exports related to matrix event types, relation types, and message content structures for a Matrix client or application.

methods.name: EventType
methods.description: Defines string constants for different matrix event types such as messages, encrypted messages, members, location, and reactions.

methods.name: RelationType
methods.description: Defines string constants for relation types like replacements and threads.

methods.name: RoomMessageEventContent
methods.description: Type describing the content of a room message event, including optional URL, encrypted file, info with mimetype and size, and relations.
